notes: Vana Parva. Yudhishthira calm eldest. Brothers fallen at lake. Yaksha = luminous spirit, later revealed as Dharma.

yudhishthira.face: Gentle eldest Pandava, light dark mustache, composed wise eyes, serene resolve
yudhishthira.hair: Black hair simple topknot, no peacock
yudhishthira.costume: Cream or soft gold dhoti, modest exile dress, simple sacred thread

bhima.face: Powerful younger brother, thick dark mustache, broad face

arjuna.face: Young archer, thin dark mustache, focused
arjuna.hair: Black topknot, no peacock in exile

nakula_sahadeva.face: Younger twins, gentle features, light mustaches

yaksha.face: Luminous spirit face, stern calm, not gory monster — comic mythology ethereal
yaksha.hair: Crown of light or wild pale hair
yaksha.costume: Glowing pale gold and mist-white robes, semi-divine presence over water
